sources.title: Creating a London Accessible to all
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's Accessible London guidance explains inclusive design principles for disabled and older people and how planning authorities should implement accessible environments; guidance is a material consideration, not parcel permission.

sources.title: Chapter 3 Design — Policy D7 Accessible housing
sources.verified_claim: London Plan Policy D7 requires at least 10% of relevant new dwellings to meet wheelchair-user standard M4(3) and the remainder to meet accessible/adaptable standard M4(2); applicability still depends on the actual development proposal.

sources.title: Housing Design
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's housing design guidance requires proposals to address a diverse population, accessible housing, inclusive site arrangements and disabled residents' travel needs; it does not evidence sample-parcel development.

sources.title: Building control
sources.verified_claim: Enfield Building Control provides regulatory approval, site visits and technical guidance for construction projects; building-control compliance is separate from proof of planning permission or parcel growth potential.

sources.title: Building regulations
sources.verified_claim: Havering states building work should meet national building-regulation standards covering structure, fire safety, ventilation, drainage, energy, access and other minimum requirements; compliance does not determine planning outcome.

sources.title: Make a building control application
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth requires relevant building work to comply with Building Regulations and provides full-plans, building-notice and regularisation routes; landlord, planning and building-control consents remain distinct.

sources.title: Search building regulation applications
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's building-regulation database covers applications from 1999 onward but explicitly says the data is incomplete and not a substitute for a formal local land-charge search; database absence is not treated as proof.

sources.title: Fire safety in Lambeth
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth explains fire-risk-assessment duties, evacuation planning and ongoing management requirements for blocks of flats and business premises; operational fire-safety duties do not establish sample-parcel planning status.
